## Equal

---


[__Bi-entity Condition Type__](https://eggolib.github.io/latest/types/bientity_condition_types/equal)

Checks if the actor entity is the target entity.

Type ID: `eggolib:equal`

---

### Examples

```json
"bientity_condition": {
    "type": "eggolib:equal"
}
```
